```

Wait, let me reconsider. The game says "game_over" but maybe that's because I reached some kind of end state. The score is 1. Let me look at this differently.
Looking at the maze more carefully:
- Row 4: bBBBWgWgWBBBBBBBBB - player at (4,0), then walls until (4,4)=W
- Row 3: gBBBgBgBgBBBBBBBBB - passages at (3,0), (3,4), (3,6), (3,8)
- Row 2: WgWgWgWgRgWgWBBBBB - horizontal corridor with R at (2,8)
- Row 1: BBBBBBBBBBBBgBBBBB - only (1,12)=g
- Row 0: BBBBBBBBBBBBNBBBBB - goal at (0,12)
The only way to reach the goal at (0,12) is through (1,12)=g, which requires being at (2,12) or (3,12) or (2,10) or (2,14). Looking at row 2, (2,10)=W, (2,12)=W, (2,14)=W. So from (2,10) I can go UP to (0,10)... no wait, (0,10)=B. From (2,12) I can go UP to (0,12)=N.
To reach (2,12), I need to come from (2,10) or (4,12). Row 4 has (4,10)=W, so (4,12) would be 2 cells right from there. But (4,12) is in the wall section of row 4, which is all B's from (4,8) onward. So that path is blocked.
